findings: RestService interface/implementation whole-read/Gitblobverified. No networking or TLS behavior exercised; review restricted to data/lifecycle contracts.

postAsXML returnsnull on JAXBException, while getNodeByHost/downloadNodeStatus dereference response without null check. Serialization failure can become later NullPointerException instead of declared TargetNodeUnreachableException; source-only.
Some other methods check response but not body, so emptybody can fail on casts/dereference; null body validation inconsistent.
Client requestfactory has no explicit connect/read/connection-pool timeout or response-size cap here. Actual defaults/dependency behavior unverified; no claim of measured unbounded wait.
Host parsing splits oncolon and interprets secondtoken integerport; malformed port and IPv6 forms not handled by local URISyntaxException catch. No network requests crafted or sent.

JAXBContext created per request with Message.class only. Earlier missingXmlSeeAlso concern remains specific to payload runtime types; response classes supplied separately. No JAXB execution, so no asserted serialization failure for particular collection.

Collection download returns deserialized Collection directly, without explicit ID/version/recipe/cardinality validation in transport. Later persistence validation still requires common NetworkService review.
Every operation uses POST and XML; HTTP4xx/5xx and resource-access errors map TargetNodeUnreachableException, conflating multiple failure categories. No retry/idempotency logic in this layer.
remaining: CommonNetworkService, remaining models/web/templates/assets/native binaries and runtime qualification
